summary: X4 Pharmaceuticals filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing a positive Type C Meeting outcome with the FDA regarding its global 4WARD Phase 3 trial of mavorixafor in chronic neutropenia. The FDA agreed to reduce the trial sample size from 176 to 126 participants while maintaining adequate power for co-primary endpoints, and accepted the proposed safety database for a potential sNDA. No transaction, securities offering, or special situation is involved. Watch trial enrollment completion by year-end 2026 and topline data expected in H1 2028; no risk-arb angle.
